remarks: San Clemente was built for life outdoors. 231 W. Avenida San Antonio takes that seriously, starting at the top. A nearly 700-square-foot rooftop deck brings together an outdoor kitchen, built-in grill, bar seating, lounge, and dining beneath a standing seam metal roofline. Below it, this newly built three-level residence — roughly 3,546 square feet, four bedrooms, six baths — is finished by Kaizen Interiors to a level that rewards a slow walkthrough. The main level opens through a covered porch into living and dining spaces. The kitchen anchors the floor around a large waterfall island with bar-top seating: a 48-inch dual-fuel range with eight burners and double convection ovens
